body:
Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-21 00:25Z, found by Sol-d50d). Worktrees on the same commit can hold Cargo.lock with DIFFERENT line endings: some checkouts are CRLF (3201 CR, 82382 bytes, raw sha 77ba7cce…), others LF (79181 bytes, raw sha a9277ae5…), with identical content (git blob a8fda1f1… = 8077d3b3:Cargo.lock). Raw SHA-256 equality then FAILS even though Cargo resolves the two identically.

For the COPY-warm rule, compare LF-normalized content (strip CR in memory) or `git hash-object --no-filters` against the commit blob, and report both the raw and the normalized results. Never copy when the normalized content differs.
